CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Signature packaging gift message is propagated to Gecco order history
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Place or replay a WCS order that contains UserData giftMessage at root level with signature packaging enabled. Open Gecco order history details for the order and inspect gift message fields.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Gift message text is present and matches the source payload.
No truncation or null substitution occurs for non-empty messages.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Product name, designer name, and image path are populated from WCS enrichment fields
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Replay an order containing ProductName, DesignerName, and ImagePath values from WCS. Inspect corresponding line items in Gecco order history.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Product name and designer name match WCS source values.
Image path field is populated for each eligible line item.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Order item image URL is correctly formatted and resolves for Porter order items
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Use a known Porter order item imported through ANT and inspect rendered image URL and thumbnail behavior in order history.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Image URL follows expected brand/path format.
Image loads successfully without broken placeholder.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Item discount uses totalProductDiscount when present and non-zero
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Replay an order where item UserData includes totalProductDiscount with a non-zero value. Compare Gecco item discount against source field.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Displayed item discount equals totalProductDiscount from source.
No secondary adjustment sum overrides the non-zero primary field.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Fallback discount calculation is applied when totalProductDiscount is missing or zero
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Replay an order with missing or zero totalProductDiscount and valid adjustment blocks. Validate resulting line-item discount in Gecco.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Discount is computed from adjustment blocks only when primary field is missing or zero.
Computed value is stable and not duplicated.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: For KR shipping addresses, PCCC is mapped to PersonID and fills AddressLine3 when blank
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Replay a KR order where PCCC exists and AddressLine3 is blank at source. Validate address data in Gecco order history payload/view.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
PersonID contains the exact PCCC value.
AddressLine3 is populated with PCCC only when originally blank.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Existing non-blank AddressLine3 is preserved for KR orders while PersonID still receives PCCC
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Replay a KR order where AddressLine3 already has content and PCCC exists. Compare source and target address fields.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
AddressLine3 original value remains unchanged.
PersonID is still populated with PCCC.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Positive discount amounts are rejected and do not create inconsistent order history records
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Inject or replay an order containing a positive discount adjustment and observe processing result and persisted state.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Processing fails fast or rejects the malformed discount payload.
No partially inconsistent discount record is persisted in order history.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Contact: Cobbe, Valentina || YOOX NET A PORTER
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Legacy image-path behavior regression is not reintroduced after image URL changes
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open at least one historical order previously validated by business for image rendering and compare with current output after deployment.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Previously valid item images still render correctly.
No regression in image host/path transformation is detected.

Conditional overwrite requirement implies preserving existing non-blank AddressLine3.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Clarify expected final image URL format when AC is vague
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Compare a sample of order item image URLs before and after rollout for Porter SKUs and confirm host/path parity with expected downstream consumers.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Image URL pattern is deterministic and consistent for all sampled items.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Incorrect URL formatting causes broken image rendering in order history UI.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: PR and Jira evidence exists, but AC text does not define exact URL pattern contract.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Malformed positive discount payload does not leave partial persisted state
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Submit a controlled malformed message with positive discount and verify no order history row is partially updated while error handling remains observable.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Payload is rejected and persistence remains unchanged.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Partial writes can corrupt customer-visible totals and trust.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: AC requires strict exception behavior; no code-level PR reference located.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: KR-only PCCC behavior does not leak into non-KR countries
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Run one KR and one non-KR order through the same flow and compare PersonID/AddressLine3 behavior.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: PCCC mapping applies only to KR orders.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Impact: Leakage to non-KR addresses could expose incorrect personal data fields.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Country-specific AC is clear; regression-style negative test is still recommended.
